name_note: The GTDB representative genome of this species is deposited in NCBI under the name Firmicutes bacterium OM04-13BH.

sentences.text: Blautia stercoris was described from a strictly anaerobic, non-spore-forming, Gram-stain-positive strain isolated from the faeces of a healthy individual.
It was most closely related to Blautia producta in the family Lachnospiraceae, and its glucose fermentation produced acetic acid as the major short-chain fatty acid.
A probiotic supplementation study reported an increased relative abundance of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii and Blautia stercoris.
A study of dance classes reported an increase in Blautia stercoris and a decrease in Ruminococcus torques within the experimental group.
Another study investigated the live biotherapeutic strain Blautia stercoris MRx0006 for attenuating behavioural deficits relevant to autism spectrum disorder.
